info.title: Tronicare Organizations Api
info.description: Source-derived HTTP contract for the Python implementation. Includes operational endpoints hidden from runtime OpenAPI. Use the base URL of this process; no production host is embedded.

200.description: Records, or the single record selected by entity_id.

422.description: Invalid path, query, JSON or wire member.

503.description: Required dependency or mutation authority unavailable.

get.description: Requires entity permission read. IdSession and other query parameters do not filter this collection. Supplying entity_id selects one record and changes the response from an array to an object. The default API runtime supplements Redis method rights with bounded caller-token Users /v1/usersadmin/context checks of current SQL actor, signed role level, organization, groups and requested method rights. Stale policy fails closed. Ordinary list and item access is limited to the current actor organization, including collection entity_id selection. PUT and DELETE check scope inside the authority transaction before state or mutation audit changes.

parameters.name: entity_id
parameters.description: Implicit FastAPI parameter: a positive decimal ID up to 9223372036854775807. GET returns that record instead of the list. POST validates this value but still allocates its own new ID.

200.description: Record returned as legacy JSON members.

422.description: Invalid path, query, JSON or wire member.

503.description: Required dependency or mutation authority unavailable.

post.description: Requires entity permission create. Mutations require both configured and database authority; otherwise HTTP 503. JSON object only; duplicate keys and non-finite numbers are rejected. Unknown members are ignored and omitted members retain their values (or defaults on create). The POST identity is allocated by the server; a PUT identity, if supplied, must match the path. The default API runtime supplements Redis method rights with bounded caller-token Users /v1/usersadmin/context checks of current SQL actor, signed role level, organization, groups and requested method rights. Stale policy fails closed. Creating a server-allocated organization requires platform level 90 or above; ordinary callers cannot create a new tenant. Persisted one-time-password sessions cannot mutate. Organization-type operations retain their applicable method rights and legacy wire/update-path contracts.

200.description: Service metadata, or Status=false and Error='bad authentication'.

get.description: Missing or invalid Token returns HTTP 200 with Status=false. Successful metadata fields depend on the worker state. Service information requires current platform level 90 or above. Ordinary authenticated callers receive 403. Public heartbeat metrics retain their existing authentication contract.
No Token header is required by this handler.
